segments.ja214:1.1: Puṇṇaṃ nadiṃ yena ca peyyamāhu, jātaṃ yavaṃ yena ca guyhamāhu;
segments.ja214:1.3: Dūraṃ gataṃ yena ca avhayanti, so tyāgato [tyābhato (syā. ka.) paheḷigāthābhāvo manasi kātabbo] handa ca bhuñja brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja214:2.1: Yato maṃ saratī rājā, vāyasampi pahetave;
segments.ja214:2.3: Haṃsā koñcā mayūrā ca [haṃsakoñcamayūrānaṃ (ka. aṭṭha. pāṭhantaraṃ)], asatīyeva pāpiyāti.
